problem.title: Error running 'filename'. The system cannot find the file specified (PyCharm)
problem.description: I have a PyCharm project on my Windows, where I am able to run most .py files by pressing Ctrl + Shift + F10 (or running the debugger). In one of the files however I get the error Error running 'test': Cannot run program "\opt\anaconda\bin\python" (in directory "..."): CreateProcess error=2, the system cannot find the file specified.` The test.py file right now only contains print('hello') I can do this for the other files, and using 'Execute selection in console' also works fine.
